WITH sens AS (
  SELECT artref AS artref, 1 AS ord, 'EnvSensitivity' AS senstype, TRIM(envsensitivity) AS sensvalue FROM sensitivitydata
  UNION ALL SELECT artref, 2, 'LightSensitivity', TRIM(lightsensitivity) FROM sensitivitydata
  UNION ALL SELECT artref, 3, 'TempSensitivity', TRIM(tempsensitivity) FROM sensitivitydata
  UNION ALL SELECT artref, 4, 'HumiditySensitivity', TRIM(humiditysensitivity) FROM sensitivitydata
),
weighted AS (
  SELECT artref, ord, senstype, sensvalue,
         CASE sensvalue WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS sensweight
  FROM sens
),
erf AS (
  SELECT artref, SUM(sensweight) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS erfscore FROM weighted GROUP BY artref
),
highs AS (
  SELECT artref, json_group_array(json_object('type', senstype, 'value', sensvalue)) AS highsensitivities
  FROM (SELECT artref, ord, senstype, sensvalue FROM weighted WHERE sensvalue = 'High' ORDER BY artref, ord)
  GROUP BY artref
)
SELECT a.artregistry AS artifactid, a.artname, erf.erfscore, highs.highsensitivities
FROM artifactscore a
JOIN erf ON erf.artref = a.artregistry
LEFT JOIN highs ON highs.artref = a.artregistry
WHERE erf.erfscore > 7
ORDER BY erf.erfscore DESC

WITH pct AS (
  SELECT r.artref AS artref,
         NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY r.histsignrating DESC) AS histpct,
         NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY r.cultscore DESC) AS cultpct
  FROM artifactratings r
),
categorised AS (
  SELECT a.artregistry, a.artname, sa.insvalueusd, a.conservestatus,
         CASE WHEN sa.insvalueusd > 1000000 THEN 'Monetary High-Value'
              WHEN p.histpct = 1 AND p.cultpct = 1 THEN 'Cultural/Historical High-Value'
              ELSE 'Other' END AS highvaluecategory
  FROM artifactscore a
  JOIN artifactsecurityaccess sa ON sa.artref = a.artregistry
  JOIN pct p ON p.artref = a.artregistry
)
SELECT artregistry AS artifactid, artname, insvalueusd, conservestatus, highvaluecategory
FROM categorised
WHERE highvaluecategory <> 'Other' AND TRIM(conservestatus) = 'Critical'

WITH base AS (
  SELECT a.artdynasty AS dynasty, TRIM(a.conservestatus) AS conservestatus, TRIM(cm.budgetallocstatus) AS budgetallocstatus,
         (r.histsignrating + r.researchvalrating + r.cultscore)
         * (10 - CASE TRIM(a.conservestatus) WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)
         / 30.0 AS cpi
  FROM artifactscore a
  JOIN artifactratings r ON r.artref = a.artregistry
  JOIN conservationandmaintenance cm ON cm.artrefmaintained = a.artregistry
),
perdynasty AS (
  SELECT dynasty,
         SUM(cpi) AS totalcpi,
         SUM(CASE WHEN budgetallocstatus = 'Adequate' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS adequatefundingcount,
         SUM(CASE WHEN budgetallocstatus = 'Insufficient' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS insufficientfundingcount,
         SUM(cpi) / (COUNT(*) * 1.0 * COUNT(*)) AS cbe,
         SUM(CASE WHEN conservestatus = 'Critical' AND budgetallocstatus = 'Insufficient' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critinsufficient
  FROM base GROUP BY dynasty
),
overall AS (
  SELECT 'ALL DYNASTIES' AS dynasty,
         SUM(cpi) AS totalcpi,
         SUM(CASE WHEN budgetallocstatus = 'Adequate' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS adequatefundingcount,
         SUM(CASE WHEN budgetallocstatus = 'Insufficient' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS insufficientfundingcount,
         SUM(cpi) / (COUNT(*) * 1.0 * COUNT(*)) AS cbe,
         SUM(CASE WHEN conservestatus = 'Critical' AND budgetallocstatus = 'Insufficient' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS critinsufficient
  FROM base
)
SELECT dynasty, totalcpi, adequatefundingcount, insufficientfundingcount, cbe,
       CASE WHEN cbe < 0.5 AND critinsufficient > 0 THEN 'Budget Crisis' ELSE 'Within Budget' END AS budgetstatus
FROM (
  SELECT dynasty, totalcpi, adequatefundingcount, insufficientfundingcount, cbe, critinsufficient FROM perdynasty
  UNION ALL
  SELECT dynasty, totalcpi, adequatefundingcount, insufficientfundingcount, cbe, critinsufficient FROM overall
)

SELECT a.artregistry AS registrynumber, a.artname, a.mattype, sd.lightsensitivity,
       CASE WHEN lr.lightlux > CASE TRIM(sd.lightsensitivity) WHEN 'High' THEN 50 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 200 END
            THEN 'Over Exposure' ELSE 'Within Limits' END AS exposurestatus
FROM artifactscore a
JOIN sensitivitydata sd ON sd.artref = a.artregistry
JOIN usagerecords u ON u.artrefused = a.artregistry
JOIN environmentalreadingscore e ON e.showcaseref = u.showcaserefused
JOIN lightandradiationreadings lr ON lr.envreadref = e.envreadregistry
WHERE TRIM(sd.lightsensitivity) IN ('High', 'Medium')

WITH base AS (
  SELECT a.artregistry, a.artname, a.mattype, u.displaydurmonths,
         r.histsignrating, r.researchvalrating, r.cultscore, TRIM(a.conservestatus) AS conservestatus,
         lr.lightlux, lr.visibleexplxh,
         CASE TRIM(sd.lightsensitivity)    WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS w_light,
         CASE TRIM(sd.tempsensitivity)     WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS w_temp,
         CASE TRIM(sd.humiditysensitivity) WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS w_hum
  FROM artifactscore a
  JOIN artifactratings r ON r.artref = a.artregistry
  JOIN sensitivitydata sd ON sd.artref = a.artregistry
  JOIN usagerecords u ON u.artrefused = a.artregistry
  JOIN environmentalreadingscore e ON e.showcaseref = u.showcaserefused
  JOIN lightandradiationreadings lr ON lr.envreadref = e.envreadregistry
  WHERE TRIM(u.displayrotatesched) = 'Active'
),
calc AS (
  SELECT artregistry, artname, mattype, displaydurmonths,
         36.0 * (10 - w_light) * (10 - w_temp) * (10 - w_hum) / 1000.0 AS dsd,
         lightlux * w_light * visibleexplxh / 1000.0 AS ler,
         (histsignrating + researchvalrating + cultscore)
           * (10 - CASE conservestatus WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)
           / 30.0 AS cpi
  FROM base
),
erps AS (
  SELECT *, (dsd - displaydurmonths) * (ler + 1) * (cpi + 1) / 100.0 AS erpsscore FROM calc
)
SELECT artregistry AS artifactid, artname, mattype, displaydurmonths, ROUND(dsd, 2) AS dsd,
       ROUND(erpsscore, 2) AS erps,
       CASE WHEN erpsscore < 0 THEN 'Immediate Rotation' ELSE 'Monitor' END AS recommendation
FROM erps

WITH base AS (
  SELECT a.artregistry, a.artname, a.artageyears, e.tempc, e.relhumidity,
         CASE TRIM(sd.envsensitivity)      WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS w_env,
         CASE TRIM(sd.lightsensitivity)    WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS w_light,
         CASE TRIM(sd.tempsensitivity)     WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS w_temp,
         CASE TRIM(sd.humiditysensitivity) WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS w_hum,
         (CASE WHEN TRIM(sd.envsensitivity)      = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN TRIM(sd.lightsensitivity)    = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN TRIM(sd.tempsensitivity)     = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        + CASE WHEN TRIM(sd.humiditysensitivity) = 'High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS highsensitivitycount
  FROM artifactscore a
  JOIN sensitivitydata sd ON sd.artref = a.artregistry
  JOIN usagerecords u ON u.artrefused = a.artregistry
  JOIN environmentalreadingscore e ON e.showcaseref = u.showcaserefused
),
calc AS (
  SELECT *, (w_env + w_light + w_temp + w_hum) / 4.0 AS erf FROM base
),
mdrcalc AS (
  SELECT *, artageyears * erf * (relhumidity - 50) * (relhumidity - 50) * tempc / 100000.0 AS mdr FROM calc
)
SELECT artregistry AS artifactid, artname, tempc, relhumidity, highsensitivitycount,
       CASE WHEN mdr > 5 AND highsensitivitycount >= 2 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS accelerateddeterioration
FROM mdrcalc

SELECT DISTINCT sc.showcasereg AS showcaseid
FROM showcases sc
LEFT JOIN environmentalreadingscore e ON e.showcaseref = sc.showcasereg
WHERE (10 - (e.tempvar24h + e.humvar24h / 5.0 + sc.leakrate) / 3.0) < 4
   OR (CASE WHEN TRIM(sc.sealcondition) = 'Poor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN TRIM(sc.maintstatus) = 'Overdue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN TRIM(sc.filterstatus) = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
     + CASE WHEN TRIM(sc.silicagelstatus) = 'Replace Now' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 3

SELECT DISTINCT e.showcaseref AS showcaseid
FROM environmentalreadingscore e
WHERE e.tempvar24h > 1 OR e.humvar24h > 3

SELECT a.artregistry AS artifactid, a.artname, a.artdynasty,
       (r.histsignrating + r.researchvalrating + r.cultscore)
       * (10 - CASE TRIM(a.conservestatus) WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10 END)
       / 30.0 AS cpiscore
FROM artifactscore a
JOIN artifactratings r ON r.artref = a.artregistry
ORDER BY cpiscore DESC

WITH base AS (
  SELECT a.artregistry, a.artageyears, e.tempc, e.relhumidity, lr.lightlux, lr.visibleexplxh,
         CASE TRIM(sd.envsensitivity)      WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS w_env,
         CASE TRIM(sd.lightsensitivity)    WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS w_light,
         CASE TRIM(sd.tempsensitivity)     WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS w_temp,
         CASE TRIM(sd.humiditysensitivity) WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 5 WHEN 'High' THEN 10 END AS w_hum
  FROM artifactscore a
  JOIN sensitivitydata sd ON sd.artref = a.artregistry
  JOIN usagerecords u ON u.artrefused = a.artregistry
  JOIN environmentalreadingscore e ON e.showcaseref = u.showcaserefused
  JOIN lightandradiationreadings lr ON lr.envreadref = e.envreadregistry
),
calc AS (
  SELECT artregistry, artageyears, tempc, relhumidity, lightlux, visibleexplxh, w_light,
         (w_env + w_light + w_temp + w_hum) / 4.0 AS erf
  FROM base
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT artregistry, erf,
         lightlux * w_light * visibleexplxh / 1000.0 AS ler,
         artageyears * erf * (relhumidity - 50) * (relhumidity - 50) * tempc / 100000.0 AS mdr
  FROM calc
)
SELECT artregistry AS artifactid, ROUND(erf + ler + mdr * 2, 2) AS tetl
FROM metrics
ORDER BY erf + ler + mdr * 2 DESC
LIMIT 10
